cc:Work.dc:title: Compilation Average History
cc:Work.dc:description: Two separate compilation measurement scopes. The upper panel shows 15 historical compiler-source checking process-time snapshots from Phase8 to Phase24, without code emission, on a logarithmic 1x to 100x axis. The source and timing windows evolve, so the snapshots are unconnected. The TypeScript reference pin changes at Phase23. The recorded ratio declines from 73.20x to 2.99x across these snapshots. The lower panel separately shows the geometric mean of checked JavaScript emission request-time ratios on the same four programs at Phase42 through Phase45, on a linear axis, ending at 8.50x. Both panels show the 1x TypeScript reference. Historical and current measurements are not joined or treated as a matched workload.
